'''Errata''' are official corrections to a card's game text after printing (or equivalent labeled text changes in rules documents).

This is a '''fan encyclopedia'''. Cite primary sources; do not invent game text.

Decipher issued many of those corrections through rules documents such as the [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Glossary Supplement]] and the [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Glossary Version 2.0 — November 1998]], often leaving the physical print unchanged. '''Players Committee''' corrections and Virtual redesigns for current play are tracked separately — see [[PC Errata]] and [[Players Committee rule changes]].

This hub has three sections, in order:

# '''Decipher Errata''' — Decipher-only corrections (printed archive vs Holotable / Glossary face).
# '''Decipher and PC Errata''' — cards with both a Decipher layer and a later Players Committee rewrite (side-by-side faces; Notes prose covers both).
# '''PC Errata''' — PC-only game-text changes (see also [[PC Errata]]).

Virtual Current Errata Sheet / Virtual redesigns do '''not''' belong in the Decipher table.

''Each Original/Errata face links to that version's card page. Decipher often left the physical print unchanged — each row shows the printed archive face versus the face used for Errata wording (or uniqueness/restriction bullets) on the wiki. Original archives display at 353px / Errata Holotable at 350px (small size nudge so faces match by eye after the flush crops). Errata Date and Errata Source cite the Decipher document that published the correction. Reason is filled only when that source states one.''


== Decipher and PC Errata ==

Cards below have a '''Decipher''' correction '''and''' a later '''Players Committee''' rewrite. Faces are shown side-by-side: '''Original''' (printed archive, 353px) | '''Errata''' (Decipher WB baseline, 350px) | '''PC Errata''' (Holotable / PC face, 350px). The '''Notes''' column is prose only (dates, sources, both layers) — not the rigid Date/Source/Reason split, and '''no''' card-face <code>[[File:...]]</code> embeds in Notes.

'''Errata Date(s):''' Decipher [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Glossary Supplement]] (Updated 29 January 2002); Players Committee [[Media:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|SWCCG 2023 Advanced Rulebook]] Appendix A — Errata.

'''Errata Source(s):''' [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Glossary Supplement]]; [[Media:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|SWCCG 2023 Advanced Rulebook]] (local PDF); Decipher.com white-border face (Wayback attackrunwb.gif).

'''Decipher:''' WB Decipher.com baseline face is the Errata-column image and the card image on bare [[Attack Run]] and [[Attack Run (Errata)]]. Game text from WB OCR + Glossary Supplement last line <code>* Your Proton Torpedoes are immune to Overload.</code> (Printed Original last line was <code>*Immune to Overload during Attack Run.</code>) Baseline Z wording is <code>Z = highest ability of TIE pilots in trench</code> — not the PC <code>opponent's</code> / <code>just before Pull Up!</code> form.

'''PC:''' Full Attack Run rewrite in AR 2023 Appendix A, including <code>Z = highest ability of opponent's TIE pilots in trench just before Pull Up!</code>. Holotable face is the '''PC Errata''' column (and on [[Attack Run (PC Errata)]]). Default [[Attack Run]] stays the Decipher WB baseline (do not overwrite with PC on the bare title).
